name: Nanofilm Technologies International Limited
summary: Nanofilm Technologies International Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides nanotechnology solutions in Singapore, China, Japan, and Vietnam. It operates through Advanced Materials, Industrial Equipment, Nanofabrication, and Sydrogen Energy segments. The Advanced Materials segment offers advanced materials through surface solution services based on vacuum coating technology across a range of industries. The Industrial Equipment segment manufactures and sells turnkey equipment systems, such as coating equipment, cleaning lines, and automation systems.
